ValidationRule.description: User should not be able to edit KYC Date.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Permission.Skip_Validations_Permission = FALSE, NOT(ISNEW()), NOT( OR( $Permission.TSEG_Premium_Guest_Services = TRUE, $Permission.TSEG_Casino_Host_Access_PS = TRUE, $Permission.TSEG_CRM_Manager = TRUE )), NOT( OR( ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Key_Date_Category__c), "KYC"), ISPICKVAL(Key_Date_Category__c, "KYC") ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Key date cannot be edited. Please contact your administrator if changes are required.
